name: Standard employee agreement v3
clause: For 24 months after employment ends, the Employee will not work for or with any competitor of the Company, in any capacity, anywhere in the United States.

name: Colorado threshold for highly compensated workers
source: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment, 2026 PAY CALC Order (7 CCR 1103-14), as reported by law firms; C.R.S. 8-2-113(2)(b)

name: Washington earnings threshold for employees
source: Washington Department of Labor and Industries, WSR 25-20-099; RCW 49.62.020 and 49.62.040

name: Illinois earnings threshold for a covenant not to compete
source: 820 ILCS 90/10(a): more than $75,000 a year, rising to $80,000 on 1 January 2027
